_comment: Pinned place->council-district mapping for the Nashville surface's lighting projection. DELIBERATELY OWNED BY THE SURFACE PIPELINE, NOT BY nashville.surfacedef.json — see CODING-LESSONS.md entry on the discovery-dialogue write race. discover-nashville.mjs rewrites the whole surfacedef (including metrics.placeDistricts) on every autonomous cycle and has no knowledge of districts, so that field must never be trusted from the live file. drive-nashville.mjs merges this file in after loading the surfacedef, every build, unconditionally.
